ruleDefinitions.name: MSI Installation From Suspicious Locations
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects MSI package installation from suspicious locations Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "MsiInstaller" AND (event_id = 1040 OR event_id = 1042) AND (Data = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*"))) AND  NOT (Data = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\WinGet\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\UpdHealthTools\\\.msi.*"))
